SqlAuthenticationProviderConfigurationSe.summary: The configuration section definition for reading app.config. This infrastructure type is not intended for direct use by application code.

remarks.para: Defines the legacy SqlAuthenticationProviders section for authentication configuration.
This type is public to support use across SqlClient assemblies and configuration section activation. Applications should not instantiate, derive from, or access this type directly.
This sealed handler derives directly from .
Referencing this handler in an app.config section declaration is supported.

The current SqlClientAuthenticationProviders section takes precedence. An incompatible current handler is traced and ignored, allowing this legacy section to be used. Configuration-reading errors produce empty settings without fallback.

Configuration reading uses a relaxed policy that traces and ignores configuration-reading, handler, schema and broker-value errors. Ignoring these errors may select unintended providers or provider settings. Explicit initializer/provider activation or registration failures abort bootstrap. Missing sections and empty optional attributes remain valid.
Recoverable bootstrap failures are cached and traced. Subsequent calls to return ; returns . Correct the configuration and restart the application.
Application stops at the first failure; earlier registrations and initializer/provider callback side effects are not rolled back.

Name.summary: The name of the legacy authentication configuration section.

Providers.value: The collection of user-defined authentication providers.

InitializerType.value: The assembly-qualified initializer type name, or an empty string when unset.

ApplicationClientId.value: The application client ID, or an empty string when unset.

UseWamBroker.summary: Forwarded to ActiveDirectoryAuthenticationProviderOptions.UseWamBroker when the Azure extension's default provider is auto-installed. Stored as a string so that an unset attribute can be distinguished from useWamBroker="false"; the runtime parses it with .
UseWamBroker.value: The Web Account Manager broker preference, or an empty string when unset.
UseWamBroker.remarks: An unset or empty value preserves the Azure provider's default broker behavior. Non-empty values must parse as a Boolean. Invalid values are traced and ignored, preserving the provider's default broker behavior and other valid settings.
